question: Where was the 29th World Gas Conference (WGC), known as the 'Olympics' of the global gas industry, held for the first time in its nearly 100-year history in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beijing, China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The 29th World Gas Conference (WGC) was held in **Beijing, China**, marking the first time the event was hosted in China since its inception nearly 100 years ago.
 
• The WGC is often referred to as the "Olympics" of the global gas industry and serves as the most significant and prestigious global gas event.
